title: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel Puppy Application
intro: Thank you for your interest in our puppies. The application takes about ten minutes, and your answers are saved on this device as you go.
disclaimer: Completing this application does not guarantee a placement or obligate you to purchase a puppy. It helps us match the right puppy with the right family and ensures our dogs go to safe, loving forever homes.
thankYouTitle: Thank you for your interest in our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel puppies!

sentMessage: We have received your application and emailed a confirmation to {email}. Laura will be in touch soon. If you don't see the email, please check your spam folder.
fallbackMessage: We could not send your application automatically. Please copy it and email it to braveheartcavaliers@gmail.com, or text it to Laura at 360-702-2367.
